question: In human beings, the small intestine is coiled and is about ______ metres long.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 to 7.5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Small intestine**

 
 
• The small intestine is the longest part of the digestive system which extends from the stomach to the large intestine.
 
• It is approximately 7 to 7.5 meters (23 to 25 feet) long.
 
• It is divided into three parts named duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.
 
• The main function of the small intestine is that it helps to complete the digestion of food and absorb nutrients.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Duodenum:

 
• This is the main component.
 
• The small intestine which takes part in digestion resembles like U shape.
 
• The duodenum is the shortest section, on average measuring from 20 cm to 25 cm in length.
 
• Its proximal end is connected to the antrum of the stomach.
 
• The distal end blends into the beginning of the jejunum.

Jejunum:

 
• It is less coiled than Ileum.
 
• The jejunum is roughly 2.5 meters in length.

Ileum:

 
• It is the more coiled structure of the small intestine.
 
• Here the maximum amount of food is absorbed into the blood.
 
• The ileum is the final portion of the small intestine, measuring around 3 meters.
 
• It ends at the cecum.
